Scrambled egg whites, roughly 150 g at about 55 kcal per 100 g, likely with a little oil, come to about 100 kcal. Home fries (roasted potatoes), roughly 110 g at about 150 kcal per 100 g, come to about 165 kcal. That gives a total of about 265 kcal for 260 g, rounded to 270.
